result.summary: Do not dispatch yet: the specified cleanup order can follow a quarantine symlink and remove an external directory.

findings.title: Validate shelf ancestors before the bottom-up cleanup
findings.body: X1 checks and removes quarantine/redacted before checking quarantine itself. lstat does not reject symlinks in intermediate path components. With quarantine pointing to an external directory containing an empty redacted directory, this sequence removes external/redacted before detecting and preserving the quarantine link. The initial gate blocks a pre-existing link, but the exported deleter and a link introduced after the gate remain exposed. Read-only verification confirmed the filesystem semantics; an in-memory execution of X1 reproduced the external removal. Criterion 14 checks surviving file bytes and the link, so it can miss deletion of an empty external directory.
findings.recommendation: Require top-down lstat validation of state and quarantine before accessing redacted, then remove validated directories bottom-up. Add a direct-sweep regression asserting that an external empty redacted directory survives a symlinked quarantine root.

next_steps: Correct X1's ancestor-validation order and extend criterion 14 before implementation.
